stem:
The diagram shows a concave mirror held close to a tooth so the tooth can be examined. Plane mirrors and convex mirrors are also available.

Which choice correctly matches the tool to the need?

options.text: A concave mirror, because it can give an enlarged image when the tooth is close to it.
A plane mirror, because every mirror always gives an enlarged image.
A convex mirror, because it gives an enlarged image of a nearby tooth.
A concave mirror, because it is chosen only when the tooth is far from the mirror.

teacher.key_rationale: A concave mirror gives an enlarged image when the object is close. Saying every mirror enlarges over-widens the rule. A convex mirror is the wrong tool for enlargement. Requiring the tooth to be far drops the close-object condition.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote plane-mirror angle figure into a close-up concave mirror with an enlarged image of a tooth.
